study_class.decision_rule: Complete and retain all 53 ordered cells. Evaluate infrastructure and conformance before outcomes. Rank all four controller arms by the frozen lexicographic development vector only after every candidate cell is present. Select a development hypothesis only if it is strictly better than BW21L-A and has zero paired walking-gate regressions; otherwise select NONE.
study_class.replicate_adequacy: The four previously exposed material profiles and three previously exposed deterministic seeds form a mechanism-development screen only. They neither estimate a sampling distribution nor provide independent validation, superiority, equivalence, population frequency, continuous friction response, or material robustness.
study_class.controls_interpretation: The four zero-scale controls verify corrected policy-relative residual semantics under each material profile. Their active balanced-wave base motor writes and broad physical influence are expected. They are not comparative outcome estimators.

mechanism_hypothesis.observation: BW20F's two treatment walking failures occurred only at authored friction 0.76 and seeds 23001 and 23003, failed only bounded lateral drift, and retained all common integrity, mechanism, application, and other walking gates. Seed 23002 at 0.76 and all treatment seeds at 0.09, 0.37, and 1.18 passed.
mechanism_hypothesis.interpretation: The pattern is non-monotonic and seed-sensitive. Retained traces show the same positive-lateral basin in the exposed 0.76 treatment/control trajectories, with residual scale changing magnitude rather than creating the direction. This motivates a branch-free lateral feedback gain screen, not a friction-conditioned controller or causal material claim.
mechanism_hypothesis.development_derived_proportional_factor: The 1.5 proportional factor reaches the existing 0.25-rad desired-heading cap at about one sixth metre rather than one quarter metre. It prospectively spans the exposed approximately 0.153-to-0.177-m terminal errors and therefore has development authority only.
mechanism_hypothesis.prospective_velocity_factor: The 2.0 velocity factor changes 0.35*sqrt(torso_length_scale) to 0.70*sqrt(torso_length_scale) as a simple declared damping span. It is not a calibrated physical threshold or causal estimate.
not_established: that a selected development arm generalizes to fresh seeds or materials
